questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
A linear model underpredicts every new value by about 4. Which revision is most reasonable?
A) decrease the intercept by 4
B) reverse the sign of every input
C) increase the intercept by about 4
D) remove the dependent variable

options.B: reverse the sign of every input
options.C: increase the intercept by about 4

questions.explanation: A consistent vertical underprediction suggests an intercept adjustment.
